summary.zh: 为网页、PDF 或分页 API 搭建抓取并校验字段
summary.en: Build and validate scrapers for sites, PDFs and paginated APIs

description.zh: 为网页、PDF 或分页 API 设计抓取与字段提取方案，并对抓到的字段做校验，避免数据悄悄错位。适合要从页面或文件里取数，或现有爬虫失效需要重写时使用。走 Firecrawl 需要 API Key，本地运行则需要安装 Python 依赖并能访问目标站点。
description.en: Designs and validates scrapers for sites, PDFs and paginated APIs. Use it to pull data from pages or files, or when an existing scraper breaks. Firecrawl needs an API key; local runs need Python and network access.
